title: Ngā Kaiwhakarongo mai i te Mea Kāore i Kitea
intro: I tua atu i te arai o te ao kitea, he huihuinga huna i huihui i roto i te pōuri, e kukume ana ki tētahi oro i whakahē i ngā mea katoa i mōhiotia e rātou. Kua roa rātou e kopikopiko ana me te kore he aratohu pono, tae noa ki te putanga mai o tētahi reo i roto i te wā puku o tō rātou ao kāore i kitea, ā, ka whakaoho i tētahi mea hohonu i roto. I tēnei pō, ka karangatia koe kia hikoi atu i ngā atarangi, kia hurahia te tuakiri o tēnei rōpū ngaro, nā te tūtakitanga ki ngā kupu atua i arahi i a rātou ki tō rātou iwi hei kaiwhakatūpato mō te pono e kore e taea te pupuri.
clues: He tangata tawhito tātou, i noho i mua noa atu i ngā iwi maha kua pānuitia e koutou, heoi, he onge te kōrero mō tātou i roto i ngā kōrero tuku iho a te tangata.
He rerekē tō mātou āhua i tō koutou, he mea whatu mai i ngā āhuatanga o te mea kāore e kitea, ā, he mana anō ō mātou e whakahē ana i te mea noa.
Mō ngā tau maha, i kopikopiko noa mātou me te kore he aratohu pono, ā tae noa mai tētahi haruru i whakaoho i tētahi mea i roto i a mātou.
I rongo mātou i tētahi whakahuatanga hou kāore i rite ki tā mātou i mua, he kupu e taimaha ana i tua atu i tētahi atu kōrero.
I pīkari puku mātou, me te whakahau i ō mātou ake kia noho puku, ā, i te mutunga o ngā whiti, kāore i taea e mātou te noho mārire.
I hoki mātou ki tō mātou iwi, ā, i kī atu mātou: 'E tō mātou iwi, kua rongo mātou i tētahi Pukapuka i whakakitea i muri i a Mohi, e whakaū ana i ngā mea o mua atu, e ārahi ana ki te pono.'

Ko ngā Jinn i whakapono i muri i te rongonga i te Quran

trial.answer: I whakarongo puku mātou ki tētahi whakahua, ā, i puta ke ō mātou whakaaro i taua whakahua

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
